```{r}
##read in individual data files and combine
pico_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/KatherineNigro/Box/01. katherine.nigro Workspace/SST_validation/data/PICO/warnick/Lodgepole_data_KW.csv") %>% 
  mutate(provenance_name=paste0(substr(provenance_name,0,2), provenance_elev_m),
         block=as.character(block))
pien_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/KatherineNigro/Box/01. katherine.nigro Workspace/SST_validation/data/PIEN/nigro/all_data_pien_forSST.csv") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(provenance_lat))
pipo_dixit_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/katherinenigro/Box/01. katherine.nigro Workspace/SST_validation/data/PIPO/dixit/Dixit_PIPO_survival.csv") %>% 
  mutate(treeID = as.character(treeID))
pipo_nigro_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/katherinenigro/Box/01. katherine.nigro Workspace/SST_validation/data/PIPO/nigro/planted_COpondo_forSST.csv") %>% 
  filter(!planting_site_name=="ML") %>%  ##removing ML since it had very different canopy conditions
  mutate(years_since_planting = as.numeric(ifelse(years_since_planting == "initial", 0, years_since_planting)))
pied_redmond_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/katherinenigro/Box/01. katherine.nigro Workspace/SST_validation/data/PIED/redmond/PUR_germdat_NigroSST_EMH_Aug2026.csv") %>% 
  mutate(provenance_name=substr(provenance_name, 0,3))
pimo_urza_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/katherinenigro/Box/01. katherine.nigro Workspace/SST_validation/data/PIMO/urza/Urza_P.monophylla_data_forSST_seedlingdata.csv") %>% 
  mutate(block=as.character(block), treeID=as.character(treeID), month.of.planting=as.character(month.of.planting), month.of.measurement=as.character(month.of.measurement))

all_data <- bind_rows(pico_data, pien_data, pipo_dixit_data, pipo_nigro_data, pied_redmond_data, pimo_urza_data) %>% 
  select(species, planting_site_name, planting_site_lat, planting_site_lon, planting_site_elev_m, provenance_name,provenance_lat, provenance_lon, provenance_elev_m) %>% 
  unique()
```

```{r}
##process data and calculate climate match scores for all transfers in all studies

all_match_scores_mcmt_shm<- getmatchscores(data=all_data, varList=c("MCMT","SHM"), refperiod="Normal_1961_1990.nrm", targetperiod= c("Normal_1991_2020.nrm", "8GCMs_ensemble_ssp245_2011-2040.gcm"), mcmt_TL=2) ##this took ~1 min

```
